slide_title:
Multi-Class Classification using
[ONE VS ALL] Binary Classifiers

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top in two lines; slide number '7' in a circle at top-right; large central rectangular plot area containing three decision boundaries and three class regions; no footer or additional text strips visible.

regions.name: title
regions.content: Two-line title: 'Multi-Class Classification using' in red, '[ONE VS ALL] Binary Classifiers' with bracketed text in blue and the rest in red.

regions.name: main plot
regions.content: 2D classification diagram with red, green, and blue decision boundary lines; shaded regions C₁, C₂, C₃; colored dots; '+ ve' annotations.

layout.hierarchy: Title text dominates at top (largest, bold, red/blue). Central plot diagram is the largest visual element. Yellow class-label boxes (C₁, C₂, C₃) are small but high-contrast. Decision-boundary labels d₁(x), d₂(x), d₃(x) are medium-sized and color-matched to their lines.

visual_elements.description: Two-dimensional one-vs-all classification plot. Three straight decision boundaries cross the plot: a red line labeled d₁(x) descending from upper-left to lower-right; a green line labeled d₂(x) ascending from lower-left to upper-right; a blue line labeled d₃(x) ascending more steeply from lower-left to upper-right. Three shaded half-plane regions are shown: C₁ (light green diagonal hatching, top region) containing green circular dots; C₂ (light blue/purple diagonal hatching, right region) containing blue circular dots; C₃ (light red/pink diagonal hatching, bottom-left region) containing red circular dots. Each boundary has a '+ ve' text annotation with a colored arrow indicating the positive side: red '+ ve' near the lower-right end of the red line, green '+ ve' near the left side of the green line, blue '+ ve' near the upper-right end of the blue line.
visual_elements.position: center, spanning roughly 18% to 83% of slide width and 22% to 92% of slide height

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold, split into two lines: line 1 'Multi-Class Classification using' in red; line 2 '[ONE VS ALL] Binary Classifiers' with '[ONE VS ALL]' in blue and 'Binary Classifiers' in red. Class labels C₁/C₂/C₃ are bold black text inside yellow rectangles. Decision-boundary labels d₁(x)/d₂(x)/d₃(x) use matching line colors (red/green/blue) with subscript numerals. '+ ve' annotations are black.
animation_state: static; no mid-build or partial-reveal indicators visible.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#E6E6E6).
2. Add a title text box at the top center. Type line 1: 'Multi-Class Classification using' in bold red sans-serif. Type line 2: '[ONE VS ALL] Binary Classifiers' with '[ONE VS ALL]' in bold blue sans-serif and 'Binary Classifiers' in bold red sans-serif.
3. Insert a thin-outlined circle in the top-right corner with white fill and the number '7' in black.
4. Draw a large white rectangle with a thin red border in the center to serve as the plot frame.
5. Inside the plot, draw three straight lines across the full width/height: a red line sloping downward from upper-left to lower-right; a green line sloping upward from lower-left to upper-right; a blue line sloping upward more steeply from lower-left to upper-right. Add arrowheads at the ends of each line.
6. Label the red line 'd₁(x)' in red near its upper-left end; label the green line 'd₂(x)' in green near its right side; label the blue line 'd₃(x)' in blue near its upper-right end.
7. Shade three regions with diagonal hatching: top region light green; right region light blue/purple; bottom-left region light red/pink.
8. Place a yellow rectangle with bold black text 'C₁' in the green region; 'C₂' in the blue region; 'C₃' in the red region.
9. Scatter green circular dots in the C₁ region, blue circular dots in the C₂ region, and red circular dots in the C₃ region.
10. Add '+ ve' text in black near each boundary with a matching colored arrow: red arrow near the red line's lower-right end, green arrow near the green line's left side, blue arrow near the blue line's upper-right end.
